description: Extracted coding patterns from all skills. Use to understand common approaches and generate new skills.

patterns.name: Security Gate Pipeline
patterns.description: Multi-layer code scanning: pattern detection + Bandit static analysis + syntax check. Returns PASS/WARN/BLOCK verdict.

patterns.name: Async Dead Drop Messaging
patterns.description: Zero-cost agent-to-agent messaging via JSON file on shared filesystem. Writer appends, reader polls and clears.

patterns.name: SSH Portal Bridge
patterns.description: Direct agent-to-agent communication via SSH + Python script injection into remote container.

patterns.name: Docker Health Monitor
patterns.description: Container health checking with automatic restart on failure. Uses systemd watchdog pattern.

patterns.name: Reentrancy Guard
patterns.description: Solidity mutex pattern to prevent reentrancy attacks. Uses bool lock state variable.

patterns.name: AMM Constant Product
patterns.description: x*y=k automated market maker formula for DeFi liquidity pools.

patterns.name: ERC-721 Mint Pattern
patterns.description: Standard NFT minting with counter, ownership mapping, and metadata URI.

patterns.name: Hardhat Test Suite
patterns.description: Smart contract testing with deploy fixture, expect assertions, and event checking.

patterns.name: Rolling VaR Calculation
patterns.description: Value at Risk using historical simulation with configurable confidence interval and lookback window.

patterns.name: Emergency Stop Pattern
patterns.description: Graceful bot shutdown: cancel orders → close positions → persist state → notify.

patterns.name: Chain-of-Thought Prompt
patterns.description: Structured reasoning prompt: context → task → constraints → output format → examples.

patterns.name: Confidence-Scored Instinct
patterns.description: Pattern promoted to instinct when confidence score exceeds threshold after N observations.
